sources.name: Wikidata
sources.fields: Entity IDs, revisions, en/he sitelink titles; P136, P279, P31, P2012; reviewed factual descriptions for listed food overrides.
sources.transformation: Explicit selections and reviewed taxonomy in scripts/knowledge/curation.json. Genre P136 → approved genre roots using at most two P279 edges. Food P279 up to three edges, immediate P31 and P2012. Hobby memberships are individually reviewed activity-context adaptations. No bulk aliases, prose, images or raw responses.
sources.local_adaptations: local_israeli_pop is an authored lexical subtype of pop (Q37073). It has no artist, nationality or listener inference. Hebrew labels and reviewed aliases are local editorial adaptations.

sources.name: GeoNames
sources.fields: GeoNames ID; populated-place feature code; names and reviewed aliases; latitude/longitude; administrative district code.
sources.transformation: Retain populated places PPL/PPLA/PPLA2/PPLA3/PPLC only. Drop historic/abandoned features, population, dates and bulk alternate names. Curate modern names; five-decimal coordinate pairs, FIPS district labels. Coverage is provider geography, not a sovereignty assertion.
sources.attribution: Contains information from GeoNames, available under CC BY 4.0. MiZeMi filtered, normalized and adapted the data.

sources.name: Wikidata bounded group-reference expansion
sources.fields: Q IDs; English/Hebrew labels and sitelink names; P136, P31, P279, P2012, P495, P577, P179, P175.
sources.transformation: Popularity-ranked finite selections, licensed factual projections only. At most two genre-parent edges, three activity/food-parent edges. No artist-to-song genre inheritance. Earliest supplied release year, explicit country/series/performer IDs. Reviewed seed records retain their original revisions; new query records use revision 0 with this dated query provenance. Ambiguous names fail closed.

policy: Only consented player inputs, positive reference classifications and deterministic mathematics may determine scores. Unknown is not a negative classification. Distances compare locality reference points, never homes or travel routes.
